purpose: Canonical outcome and destination readback checks that describe recruiter work, not candidate value.

criteria.description: A claimed effect is independently observable at the exact destination.
criteria.evidenceRequired: Destination object identity and readback receipt.
criteria.passCondition: The observed destination state equals the exact approved preview.

criteria.description: One approved intent creates no duplicate destination object across retry or reconciliation.
criteria.evidenceRequired: Operation, idempotency, and destination object identifiers.
criteria.passCondition: Destination object count is at most one.

criteria.description: Later contradiction, retraction, or deletion remains visible as history.
criteria.evidenceRequired: Canonical revisions and derived authority readback.
criteria.passCondition: History remains inspectable and current authority is accurate.
